decision_conditions: <div>The first floor&nbsp;rear extension, by reason of its excessive bulking and massing&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">in combination with the existing side extension and ground floor rear extension</span>,&nbsp;would appear&nbsp;an overly dominant addition in relation to the size of the modest end of terrace host dwelling and&nbsp;the surrounding modest terrace dwellings. As such, the proposed development is contrary to:</div><div><br></div><div><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;</span>National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt; line-height: 14.98px;">- Policies D1, D4, D5 and D6 of the London Plan (March 2021)<o:p></o:p></span></p><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- Policies DMD1, DMD5 and&nbsp;</span>SP2&nbsp;<span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">of&nbsp;</span>The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt; line-height: 14.98px;">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</span></p></div>

<div>The scale, siting and design of the proposed development would result in unacceptable loss of daylight, overshadowing,<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;loss of outlook and overbearing impacts</span>&nbsp;impacts to no.65 &amp; 71 Surrey Road. Therefore, the proposal would constitute unneighbourly development which is contrary to:</div><div><br></div><div><p style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="">- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;</span>National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024);<o:p></o:p></p><p style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="">- Policy D6 of the London Plan (March 2021);</span><o:p></o:p></p><p style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="">- Policies DMD1, DMD5 and DMSI3 of&nbsp;</span>The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024); and</p><p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="line-height: 14.98px;">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</span></p></div>
